New-code architecture.question: Where does the monthly data spine live? Quarterly incumbent is frozen (769 tests must stay green).
New-code architecture.answer: New parallel subpackage — e.g. trading_crab_lib/platform/ with its own ingestion, splicing, and checkpoint namespace (monthly_*). Reuses existing fetchers as imports where possible; incumbent code untouched. Cleaner migration unit for Phase 6.

Splicing policy.question: How do long histories relate to tradable tickers?
Splicing policy.answer: Model index, trade ETF — each asset CLASS gets one spliced research series (S&P TR from Shiller/multpl → SPY era; LBMA/macrotrends gold → GLD; WTI → oil proxy; CMT-derived Treasury TR → TLT). Models score the class; report maps to the tradable ticker.

Splicing policy.question: Store daily raw prices and derive monthly spine, or monthly only?
Splicing policy.answer: Daily raw → monthly spine — persist daily where sources provide it; resample to monthly modeling spine. Phase-4 daily tripwire needs daily data.

ALFRED scope.question: Which agency series get true point-in-time vintage treatment in v1?
ALFRED scope.answer: Minimal revision-prone set — vintages only for revision-heavy agency series used in labeling/features: GDP, CPI, UNRATE, INDPRO, PAYEMS (+GNP if kept). Everything else keeps publication-lag shift. Market-observed series never need vintages.
